title: Ternary splice models at 100, 666 and 999
question: what changes if the splices at 100, 666 and 999 each splice into three?

verdict.conclusion: interpreting three as three new carriers, three total branches, or three internal states changes the population and representation theory but not the bounded-window zero verdict. All eighteen scenario/schedule paths have only critical-line zeros through height 30 at the selected cutoffs; none removes the escaping-quartet obstruction.

threeNew.meaning: each named event contributes a cohort of three new carriers

threeTotal.meaning: one incoming path becomes three outgoing paths, so the net new cohort has size two

threeState.meaning: one scalar carrier has a Z_3 internal state; without state-dependent coupling no new theta carrier appears
threeState.scalarConsequence: the invariant scalar completion sees only the mean channel

populationConvention: in the three-new and three-total models the existing cohort at 100 is replaced by size three or two; 666 and 999 add cohorts of the same size. The distinguished station 333 is not assigned a ternary cohort in this isolated hypothesis.
delayLaw: named-event depth is log_10(q), shifted by one in the reindexed origin model; each event has its own clock and chronological age N-log_10(q) or equal local ticks N

finiteCompletion.formula: Xi(s)=1/2+[s(s-1)/2] integral_1^infinity sum_B (1-g_B) sum_(m in B) exp(-pi m^2 x) [x^(s/2)+x^((1-s)/2)] dx/x
finiteCompletion.limit: every fixed carrier coefficient tends to one along cofinal clocks, so every family tends locally uniformly to xi

representationAssessment.consequence: a symmetric scalar trace cancels the two nontrivial phase channels; a spectral effect requires a derived coupling that distinguishes them

stressFamily.consequence: ternary branching does not prevent an off-line quartet from escaping upward while all completion symmetries and the compact xi limit are preserved

logicalAssessment.robustResult: no off-line zero detected through height 30 in any of eighteen tested paths
missingConditions: a TTI rule deciding whether three counts new carriers, total branches or internal states
a state-dependent coupling if the nontrivial Z_3 channels are to affect the scalar completion
a derived clock law for 100, 666 and 999
uniform-in-height zero control excluding escaping quartets
logicalAssessment.status: ternary splicing changes finite multiplicity but does not establish RH
